title: From Seed to Plate: Onion Farming Process Explained 1. Onion Farming Journey: From Seeds to Markets 2. Growing Giants...
reason: The video describes the entire process of onion farming from planting to processing.

tasks.task: Explain the global importance and nutritional benefits of onions.

subtasks.text: Note that onions are grown worldwide with the largest producers being China, India, and the United States.
Mention that onions are crucial for flavor and are packed with essential nutrients like vitamins B and C.

tasks.task: Describe the seed treatment and planting process for onions.

subtasks.text: Describe the seed treatment process, including soaking seeds in warm water for 12 to 24 hours.
Explain the sowing of treated seeds into seed trays or nursery soil.

tasks.task: Highlight the care and cultivation of growing onions.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of drip irrigation to conserve water and enhance plant development.
Note that farmers use organic fertilizers to enhance the growth of onions.

tasks.task: Detail the harvesting and post-harvest processes of onions.

subtasks.text: Mention that when onions reach maturity, their tops fall over, signaling it's time to harvest.
Describe the process of carefully pulling or lifting onions to prevent damage.

tasks.task: Explain the modern processing and distribution of onions.

subtasks.text: Mention the sorting of onions by size and quality in modern processing plants.
Note the use of conveyor and automatic sorters to speed up the process.
